title: `Core\Program::implementingWith<I, T>($member)` joins the enumeration with one attribute per class
scope:
one compiler-owned member joining `rule:programs/implementing`'s enumeration with
`rule:attributes/structural-retrieval`'s retrieval. What a retrieval target may be, and what the
enumeration answers, are unchanged and stay with their own records.
validatedBy: the four cases and the checker test the rule's `guardedBy` names.
